result.topic_en: Calculations with congruences and inequalities for integers a, b, t, w, and the derived quantities a_1 = a-(b+t), t_1 = t-(a+b), written on the back of a subscription form for the P.-P. Dehérain medal.
result.transcription:
$a_1 = a-(b+t)$ ; $t_1 = t-(a+b)$
$b+t_1 = b+\{t-(a+b)\} = (b+t)-(a+b)$
$a-(b+t_1) = a-(b+t)-(a+b) = a-(b+t) = a_1$

$w > a_1 > a$
$a-(b+w) = (a-b)+w$
$a-(b+t) = a-(b+t_1) > a-(b+w) = (a-b)+w$

$t$ eingliedrig, also auch $t_1 = [\mu]$
Da $\mu \equiv 0$ (mod. $a+b$), so kann man
[-$\nu \equiv 0$ (mod. $a$), $\nu \equiv \mu$ (mod. $b$)-] [-setzen-]
$\nu$ bestimmt Mod. $(a-b)$
$\nu \equiv 0$ (mod. $a$), $\nu \equiv \mu$ (mod. $b$)
daraus $\nu \equiv 0$ (mod. $a+b$)
also auch $\nu \equiv 0$ (mod. $a_1$)
$\left\{ \begin{array}{l} w = [\nu] > a_1 \\ a-b > a_1 \end{array} \right\}$ also [?] [?]
$(a-b)+w > a_1$
$\mu \equiv 0$ (mod. $b+w$) ; $\mu \equiv 0$
$t_1 > b+w$ ; $b+t_1 > b+w$

methods.what: Definition of the derived quantities a_1 and t_1
Showing that replacing t by t_1 leaves a_1 unchanged
Rule for a difference with a sum
Construction of nu via simultaneous congruences, determined modulo (a-b)
Inequality derived from w > a_1 and a-b > a_1
